proposal.title: Vakynmib: a tracker classification list with an open review process
proposal.summary: Vakynmib builds a tracker classification list with an open review process for makers of privacy tools.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.text: Tracker lists are curated without a public review of their entries. Makers of privacy tools depend on browser privacy every day, yet the tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text: We will build a tracker classification list with an open review process called Vakynmib. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

sections.heading: Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
sections.text: Browser privacy is part of the Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

sections.heading: Team and experience
sections.text: We maintain http://forge.test/vakynmib/vakynmib-next, which 286 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on browser privacy for 7 years.

sections.heading: Deliverables and licence
sections.text: All code will be released under the MPL-2.0 licence in http://forge.test/vakynmib/vakynmib-next. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

sections.heading: Milestones
sections.text: The work runs over 10 months in 4 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 2. Core implementation ends in month 5. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 7. Documentation and release ends in month 10.

sections.heading: Budget justification
sections.text: The plan asks for 61950.00 EUR for 100 days of work over 4 tasks. Day rates range from 550.00 EUR to 800.00 EUR.

proposal.narrative:
Problem

Approach

We maintain http://forge.test/vakynmib/vakynmib-next, which 286 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on browser privacy for 7 years.
